scale.source: CLDR RBNF bg renders 10^9 as "един милиард" and 10^12 as "един трилион": Bulgarian names 10^9 "милиард" and counts the -illions in the short scale.

group_mark.source: CLDR common/main/bg.xml (unicode-org/cldr c0b65ae), number symbols: the group symbol is U+00A0, a no-break space. No dot groups digits.

decimal_mark.source: CLDR common/main/bg.xml (unicode-org/cldr c0b65ae), number symbols: the decimal symbol is a comma.

space_groups.source: CLDR common/main/bg.xml (unicode-org/cldr c0b65ae), number symbols: the group symbol is a no-break space, so groups of three digits after a space are one number.

plural_scale_needs_count.source: CLDR RBNF bg writes a plural scale word only after its count ("две хиляди", 2000). A plural scale word with no count names an amount, not a number. Wiktionary (en), "хиляда": in the plural, "an extremely large number; myriad, thousands, countless".

scale_noun_agrees.source: CLDR RBNF bg %spellout-cardinal-masculine renders 10^6, 2 x 10^6, 5 x 10^6 and 21 x 10^6 as "един милион", "два милиона", "пет милиона", "двайсет и един милиона": the scale noun takes the number and case its count governs. The scale words of this lexicon are scale_numeral entries whose plural flag carries that agreement.

joiner_tens_units.source: CLDR RBNF bg renders 21 as "двайсет и един": "и" joins the last two parts of a number; reading also accepts it left out.

joiner_after_hundred.source: CLDR RBNF bg renders 101 as "сто и един" and 345 as "триста четиресет и пет": "и" goes only before the last part.

joiner_between_groups.source: CLDR RBNF bg renders 1001 as "хиляда и един": "и" before the last part also joins groups.

joiner_before_round_hundred.source: CLDR RBNF bg renders 1100 as "хиляда сто" and 1500 as "хиляда петстотин": no joiner stands before a round hundred after the thousands. Wiktionary (en), "хиляда": "хиляда осемстотин и петдесета година" also puts "и" only before the last part.

hundred_counts_below_thousand.source: unicode-rbnf 2.4.1 (CLDR RBNF bg data), %spellout-cardinal, rendering of 2100: "две хиляди сто": the hundred after the thousands is the next group, so a hundred multiplier takes no count of a thousand or more.

comma_between_classes.source: CLDR RBNF bg writes no comma between two classes (1001, 1100 and 1500 in the joiner settings above). No source opened shows a comma between two classes of one number, so a comma ends a number.

joiner_before_last_group.source: CLDR RBNF bg renders 1001 as "хиляда и един" and 1100 as "хиляда сто": "и" stands before a last unit but not before a round hundred, so the joiner before the last group is not required.

ordinal_style.source: CLDR RBNF bg renders 21 in %spellout-ordinal-masculine as "двайсет и първи": only the last word is ordinal.

bare_noun_counts_one.source: Bulgarian puts no article before a singular collective or fraction noun, which alone counts one. Wiktionary (en), "половин": "половин година", "half a year".

decimal_fractions.source: CLDR RBNF bg renders 2.5 as "две цяло и пет", with the decimal digits as a cardinal; this lexicon has no read source for a power-of-ten fraction after "цяло".

joiner_after_decimal_marker.source: CLDR RBNF bg: "x.x: << цяло и >>;": "и" follows the decimal marker.

joiner.source: CLDR RBNF bg: "и" joins the last part of a number ("двайсет и един").

decimal_marker.source: CLDR RBNF bg: "x.x: << цяло и >>;". Уикипедия (bg), "Десетичен знак": the decimal mark is the "десетична запетая"; reading запетая aloud for it is a paraphrase, with no page quote.

minus_idioms.source: This lexicon lists no Bulgarian idiom that puts "минус" before a positive number.

article_one.source: "един" also stands before a noun as an indefinite article, so alone before a noun it is a weak number. Wiktionary (en), "един", gives only the numeral sense: this is a paraphrase of usage, not a page quote.

of.source: Bulgarian has no "of" that multiplies a scale word.

fraction_of.source: Bulgarian has no "of" between a fraction and a collective.

denominator_particle.source: Bulgarian has no particle like Portuguese "avos".

class_noun.source: Bulgarian names no digit class with a singular noun after a collective.

half_unit.source: Wiktionary (en), "половин": "половин килограм", "half a kilogram": the half is its own word, read by the half role.

abbreviation.source: No Bulgarian number word in this lexicon is also an abbreviation with a period.

lone_decimal_mark.source: CLDR common/main/bg.xml (unicode-org/cldr c0b65ae): the decimal symbol is a comma; a comma before the first digit marks decimals.

ordinal_suffix_mark.source: CLDR RBNF bg %digits-ordinal-masculine: "0: =#,##0=-$(ordinal,one{ви}two{ри}few{ти}other{и})$;": the ordinal ending follows the digits after a hyphen.

range_cue.source: Wiktionary (en), "между": "between (in the position or interval that separates two things)"; "и" joins the two limits, so it ends the first number.
